meta.title: 小个子秒变大长腿拍照姿势
meta.title_en: Poses That Make Petite Girls Look Tall

scenes.context: 想拍全身不会拍，分享五个简单好学又出片的显高姿势。
sentences: 假如你想拍全身 不会拍。
If you want a full-body shot but don't know how.
full-body shot（全身照）
五个显高拍照姿势。
Five poses that make you look taller.
taller（更高的）
简单好学又出片。
Easy to learn and great for photos.
great for photos（出片）
paraphrase: 换种说法表达不会拍全身
换种说法表达姿势效果
These simple poses instantly add height.
scenes.speak: If you want a full-body shot but don't know how, try these five poses that make you look taller. Easy to learn and great for photos.

scenes.context: 动作一三脚前伸松手伸腰；动作二后插腰提包单抬腿。
sentences: 动作一 三脚前伸松手伸满腰。
Pose one: step one foot forward and stretch your waist.
step forward（向前迈）
动作二 后插腰提包单抬腿。
Pose two: hand on hip, hold a bag, lift one leg.
hand on hip（叉腰）
paraphrase: Push one leg out front and arch your waist.
Rest a hand on your waist and raise a leg.
scenes.speak: Pose one: step one foot forward and stretch your waist. Pose two: hand on hip, hold a bag, lift one leg.

scenes.context: 动作三侧身向后走背头看镜头；动作四侧身抬腿伸腰提鞋跟。
sentences: 动作三 侧身向后走背头看镜头。
Pose three: walk sideways and glance back at the camera.
glance back（回头看）
动作四 侧身抬腿伸腰提鞋跟。
Pose four: lift a leg, stretch, and touch your heel.
heel（鞋跟）
paraphrase: Turn to the side and look over your shoulder.
换种说法表达提鞋跟动作
Raise a leg and reach for your shoe heel.
scenes.speak: Pose three: walk sideways and glance back at the camera. Pose four: lift a leg, stretch, and touch your heel.

scenes.context: 发包假装往前走抓拍，动态感让整体更显高。
sentences: 动作五 发包假装往前走抓拍。
Pose five: pretend to walk forward and have it snapped.
snap（抓拍）
paraphrase: Fake a casual walk and let the camera catch it.
换种说法表达抓拍效果
The motion makes the shot feel alive and taller.
scenes.speak: Pose five: pretend to walk forward and have it snapped. The motion makes the shot feel alive.

practice: If you want a full-body shot but don't know how.
Pose two: hand on hip, hold a bag.
Walk sideways and glance back at the camera.
Pretend to walk forward and have it snapped.
pitfalls: 记住核心：延伸+拉伸+动感
五个动作都围绕这三个逻辑
shifts: 前伸、抬腿、走动组合出片
